name: Arab Revolt

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of black, green and white, with a red triangle at the hoist.
flag.symbolism: The stripes are said to recall the Abbasid (black), Fatimid (green) and Umayyad (white) caliphates, and the red the Hashemite family that led the revolt.

hook: The Arab Revolt flag runs black, green, white with a red triangle; Palestine swaps the green and white, and Jordan does the same and adds a white star.
trivia: Its colors became the pan-Arab colors, used today in the flags of Jordan, Palestine, Sudan, Kuwait and the United Arab Emirates, among others.
The design is usually credited to the British diplomat Sir Mark Sykes.
